The literal empty array is baked into the Host's durable completion representation while the Harness core semantic rule (agent_stack.py:753) only constrains what an emitted candidate_completed may contain, and host_assigned.py:369 carries the same constraint message. The loss is therefore in the Host's hard-coded completion record construction path — the Host writes an empty list without reading, copying, or surfacing the delegate's real unresolved_unknowns, so any uncertainty the Harness produced for the completed turn is dropped at the Security/Host boundary. This is a narrow Representation-path defect: it does not change Harness core semantics (the candidate_completed constraint message and contract are left intact) but the Host's own durable record that should preserve and testify to the exact unresolved uncertainty instead substitutes an empty list.
